items.name: Yossi & Dana Cohen
items.text: We saved over ₪120,000 over the life of the mortgage. The Kavodov team was available for every question and handled everything with real professionalism. Highly recommended!

items.name: Shira & Micha Levy
items.text: As first-time buyers we understood nothing — they explained everything patiently, built us an excellent mix and submitted to three banks. We got terms we never thought we'd reach.

items.name: Avi Berkovitz
items.text: I wanted to invest in real estate but had no idea where to start with the financing. The advice from Kavodov was precise and fast, and in the end I closed an excellent deal.

monthly.title: Monthly payment calculator
monthly.subtitle: Calculate your expected monthly payment from amount, rate and term
monthly.resultSub: About {{pct}}% of a net income of {{income}}

tips.fix: A fixed index-linked rate gives you planning certainty — but the prime rate may be cheaper in the short term.
tips.prime: The prime rate follows Bank of Israel decisions — suitable if you can absorb changes in your payment.
tips.var: A variable rate suits a short horizon — model a 2% rate increase before you commit.

refi.breakevenSub: After this period you're in profit
refi.cta: Want us to refinance for you? ›

afford.title: Borrowing capacity calculator
afford.subtitle: How large a mortgage can you take based on your income?
afford.resultSub: Based on the 30% rule applied to disposable income of {{amount}}/month
afford.tip: Israeli banks allow a monthly repayment of up to 40% of net income, but 30% is the safer ceiling for financial resilience.

amort.title: Amortization table
amort.subtitle: Principal and interest breakdown for every month over the life of the mortgage

mix.title: Building a track mix
mix.subtitle: Model a combination of up to 3 tracks and check the total repayment
mix.warning: ⚠️ Track total ({{tracks}}) differs from the mortgage total ({{total}})
mix.tip: A balanced mix across tracks reduces risk — fixed index-linked combined with prime is the most popular choice in Israel.

compare.title: Comparing bank offers
compare.subtitle: Enter up to 4 offers and see who gives the best terms
compare.tip: A 0.25% rate difference on a ₪1M mortgage over 25 years is worth about ₪37,000 over the life of the loan. Worth haggling for!
